# `page.renumber`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/page.renumber.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`page.renumber`: renumbers folio numbers (FR-PAG-007). References are by ID, so every xref, tag and
TOC row follows without further ops.

The pages in scope are ordered by (section number, folio number, label in natural order, ID); pages
sharing a folio number (sub-pages) keep their labels and move together. With `keep_gaps`, a page gets
`start + (old − first_old) × step`; without, the i-th distinct old number (from 0) becomes
`start + i × step`. `step` is at least 1. A new folio that equals the folio of a page outside the scope
in the same section is rejected. Bulk.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `keep_gaps` | boolean | no | `false` | Keep the gaps between the old numbers. |
| `scope` | [`PageScope`](#pagescope) | yes |  | The pages to renumber. |
| `start` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The first new number. |
| `step` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | no | `1` | The increment; default 1. |

## Types

### PageScope

Which pages `page.renumber` renumbers.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: The listed pages.

   Shape: object { `pages`: array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `pages` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: Every page of a section.

   Shape: object { `section`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `section` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2). |

3. **Form 3**: Every page of the project.

   Shape: `"project"`

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

This is a bulk command: a log line runs it as a preview first and commits the previewed result ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)).
